# QrEcc

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The error correction level in a QR Code symbol. Higher levels provide more redundancy at the cost of reduced data capacity.

Copyright (c) Project Nayuki. (MIT License) https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library Ported to C# for BonniePDF.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`High`](#high): High error correction: ~30% of codewords can be restored.
- [`Low`](#low): Low error correction: ~7% of codewords can be restored.
- [`Medium`](#medium): Medium error correction: ~15% of codewords can be restored.
- [`Quartile`](#quartile): Quartile error correction: ~25% of codewords can be restored.
